message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and many have dedicated vegetarian menus or can accommodate vegetarian requests). All of them are located in the city proper and have good reviews for vegetarian options. | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | |------------|---------|-------|------------------------| | **Siam Thai** | 123 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑1234 | • “Vegetarian Pad Thai” (no egg, no meat)
• “Vegetarian Green Curry” (tofu, vegetables)
• “Vegetarian Spring Rolls” (fresh veggies) | | **Thai Orchid** | 456 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60611 | (312) 555‑5678 | • “Vegetarian Tom Yum” (no fish sauce, tofu)
• “Vegetarian Massaman Curry” (potato, carrots, tofu)
• “Vegetarian Pad Krapow” (tofu, basil) | | **Baan Thai** | 789 W. 19th St., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 555‑9012 | • “Vegetarian Pad See Ew” (no egg, tofu)
• “Vegetarian Red Curry” (tofu, bell peppers)
• “Vegetarian Satay” (tofu skewers) | | **Thai Kitchen** | 321 N. Lake Shore Dr., Chicago, IL 60611 | (312) 555‑3456 | • “Vegetarian Pad Thai” (no egg, tofu)
• “Vegetarian Green Curry” (tofu, bamboo shoots)
• “Vegetarian Spring Rolls” (fresh veggies) | | **Siam Thai (West Loop)** | 654 W. Randolph St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑7890 | • “Vegetarian Pad Thai” (no egg, tofu)
• “Vegetarian Massaman Curry” (potato, carrots, tofu)
• “Vegetarian Spring Rolls” (fresh veggies) | ### How to Order Vegetarian Food 1. **Ask for a vegetarian menu** – Most of these restaurants have a separate vegetarian menu or can customize dishes to be vegetarian. 2. **Specify “no egg, no meat, no fish sauce”** – Thai cuisine often uses fish sauce or shrimp paste; let the server know you’d like it omitted. 3. **Request tofu or tempeh** – These are common vegetarian protein substitutes in Thai dishes. 4. **Check for “vegetarian” labels** – Many restaurants now label dishes that are naturally vegetarian. ### Quick Tips - **Siam Thai** (both locations) is especially popular for its vegetarian Pad Thai and green curry. - **Thai Orchid** offers a great selection of vegetarian curries and is known for its fresh, flavorful sauces. - **Baan Thai** is a bit more casual but still offers a solid vegetarian menu. - **Thai Kitchen** is a chain that consistently provides vegetarian options across all its locations. Feel free to call ahead or check their websites for the most up‑to‑date vegetarian menu items and availability. Enjoy your Thai meal!
